choose: Pick a product in the best sellers to see why it got its verdict, where its margin comes from and where it sold.
past: This period is over: the verdict and the stock only read on a period that runs up to today.
archived: This product is archived: archived products are not analysed, only its margin is given.

time.label: Time on sale
time.figure: {count} order since it arrived | {count} orders since it arrived
time.limit: It needs {enough}, and at least half of the period's {total} orders.
time.late: Too early: arrived late in the period

pace.label: Pace
pace.figure: {units} sold over {exposure} orders while on sale: {pace} per 100 orders
pace.limit: Limit {limit}: {percent} % of the average pace of the {type}, {average}.
pace.noLimit: No limit: no product of this type is judged yet.

margin.label: Margin per unit
margin.limit: Limit {limit}: {percent} % of their average margin per unit, {average}.
margin.noLimit: No limit: no product of this type is judged yet.

class.label: Share of the margin
class.limit: Class A: the products that make the first {a} % of the margin, class B up to {b} %, class C the rest.
class.A: Among those that earn the most
class.C: Among those that earn the least

stock.label: Stock
stock.limit: Compared with the {orders} orders of {event}, the busiest event of the period.

receipt.title: Where the margin comes from
receipt.nothing: Nothing sold in the period: no margin.
receipt.discountDetail: {average} on average per discounted unit, {share} of their full price
receipt.unknownCost: Buying cost unknown for some units: the real margin is lower.

where.title: Where it sold
where.absent: —: not on sale during the event (arrived after, or already sold out).
